scope: Proposition 4.2 of the manuscript “Single-fold Diophantine representations” (preprints/Single-fold-Diophantine-representations-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 242 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0fa6bf81ce22ef3a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are a total function g : N → N, a real constant δ > 0, and an integer u0 ≥ 4 such that the graph of g has a single-fold Diophantine representation, including uniqueness of its output and every auxiliary coordinate for each input, and δ(log u)2 < log g(u) < u log u (u ≥ u0). (7)
